script.text: Okay, straight to the point today.
Making these storytime animations solo takes a ridiculous amount of time. I'm literally drawing every single frame by hand at this desk until three in the morning.
And honestly, it gets pretty lonely sitting in this room by myself.
So, I finally set up a Discord server! It's called Nemi's Little Corner.
You can come hang out, share your art, pitch ideas for upcoming stories, or just chill quietly. The invite link is in the description.
Also, a lot of you asked how to directly support these animations, so I created a Ko-fi page.
Zero pressure at all, seriously. Just watching these videos and leaving nice comments already means the world to me.
But if you do want to chip in, it directly helps me keep animating without burning out.
Both links are right down below. Thank you so much for being here, and I'll see you in the next story.
